summary: Frontend-only testing of Expressions suite (LTE, Academic, Marriage, The Enquiry) + EnquiryQuiz (lte & global modes) + Navbar dropdown (desktop & mobile) + previous-session routing regression. 48/48 checks passed via Playwright on the public preview URL.

issues: Mobile menu overlay uses bg-bg/95 + backdrop-blur-xl but hero text/illustration visibly bleeds through behind the menu items, reducing readability of the Expressions sub-list. Consider bg-bg (solid) or a higher opacity (e.g., bg-bg/98) for the mobile menu container.

action_items: (Optional / minor) Tighten mobile menu background opacity to remove see-through to underlying hero content.
critical_code_review_comments: EnquiryQuiz majority-vote resolves a 3-way tie via Object.keys() insertion order — fine in current usage (each option array has a deterministic order matching the bucket), but if questions are ever reshuffled it could silently bias results. Consider an explicit tie-breaker.
ExpressionLTE.jsx imports SYSTEME_BOOKING_URL but the masterclass anchor uses it directly without verifying env presence — currently REACT_APP_SYSTEME_BOOKING_URL is set, so OK.

Navbar.jsx — NavDropdown opens on hover only; there is no click/tap fallback for desktop keyboard users (aria-haspopup is set but button has no onClick to open the menu). Accessibility nit, not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Expressions pages (LTE, Academic, Marriage, The Enquiry), the EnquiryQuiz (modes 'lte' and 'global', currentKey matching for Academic & Marriage), the Navbar Expressions dropdown (desktop hover + mobile sublist), and prior-session CTA routing (book-appointment-cta, footer-book-appointment, hero-explore-programmes, books-coaching-link, cta-marquee-band) all verified. No pricing/bank text on any of the 4 expression pages. No console errors. The only minor finding is a mobile-menu opacity/readability nit.
